field.label: Resolver strategy
field.help: How the resolvers in an upstream group are queried. parallel_best races two resolvers and takes the fastest answer. random picks one and asks a second if it does not respond, which is slower but sends each query to a single upstream. Both pick at random, weighted so a resolver that failed within the last hour is less likely to be chosen. strict tries them in order, moving on only when one does not respond.

field.label: Upstream timeout
field.help: Time to wait for an upstream resolver before giving up, e.g. 2s or 500ms.

field.label: Startup strategy
field.help: Behavior when connecting to upstreams at startup: blocking waits, failOnError aborts startup on failure, fast starts immediately.

field.label: HTTP User-Agent
field.help: HTTP User-Agent header sent to DoH upstreams only. Plain DNS, DoT and DoQ upstreams are not HTTP and ignore it, as do list downloads. Leave empty to send no User-Agent header.

field.label: QUIC max idle timeout
field.help: Maximum idle time before closing a QUIC connection. Only relevant when QUIC (quic:) upstreams are configured.

field.label: QUIC keep-alive period
field.help: Keep-alive interval to maintain a QUIC connection. Only relevant when QUIC (quic:) upstreams are configured.
